ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel distribution with a macro-level ratio of approximately 5:95 high-intensity (white/barnacles/water) to low-intensity (dark pigmentation) pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous region of uniform low-intensity dark pigmentation; localized high-contrast white geometric blobs clustered at coordinates corresponding to the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 12% of the fluke's vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations along the trailing edge with peak-to-valley pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 18 pixels, most pronounced on the right lobe distal edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad convex curvature extending from the median notch to the lateral lobe extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct spatial clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixel aggregates located on the dorsal and ventral margins of the lateral tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on distal fluke tips and irregular jagged margins along the trailing edge trajectory.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several pinnipeds (sea lions) surfacing in the immediate background and foreground adjacent to the whale's fluke.
